recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key photograph of a rock band performing live on a dark stage, characterized by harsh vertical chrome microphone stands and deep shadows. The layout features bold, slanted sans-serif typography positioned at the top, utilizing a tri-color scheme of light blue, orange-red, and off-white against the dark background.
coreVisualRelationships: Verticality of chrome stands vs. horizontal band arrangement
High-contrast white text against dark negative space
Dynamic diagonal tilt of the primary title vs. stable header text
Warm skin tones and orange accents vs. cool blue text and chrome highlights
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and analog texture
Deep black shadows with minimal detail in dark areas
Chrome reflections on instruments and stands

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The band occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame in a mid-shot, appearing at a 1:1 scale relative to the stage environment.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white, slanted title in the upper right quadrant acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left header, move across to the orange text, drop to the large white title, and then follow the vertical lines of the microphone stands down to the performers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space in the upper right and lower left, providing high contrast for text and chrome elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted cyan-blue and saturated orange-red (header text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between text and background; low saturation in imagery except for skin tones and specific text accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying colors and scales of the same typeface family (Oblique Sans-Serif) to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century grotesque feel and weight.
Provides the clean, industrial look of 60s typography.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, high-contrast 1960s live concert photo of a rock band. Focus on vertical chrome microphone stands, dark suits, and stage lighting that creates deep shadows. The composition should leave the top 25% of the frame mostly dark for text placement.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase, slanted sans-serif text at the top. Use a small cyan-blue and orange-red header at the very top edge, and a large off-white title in the upper right quadrant.

verificationChecks: Is there a strong vertical rhythm from the mic stands?
Is the film grain visible and authentic to the 1960s?
Is the color palette restricted to the specified tri-color set?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the orange and blue accents
Density of the vertical chrome elements
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast shadows in the band photo
Ensure text is perfectly slanted and uppercase
Verify the vertical chrome stands are prominent
Confirm the color palette is limited to black, white, cyan, and orange
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast, grainy live performance photo with a top-heavy layout of bold, slanted, tri-color sans-serif typography.
